summary: Tim DuBois is a Nashville-based music executive born in 1948 in Southwest City, Missouri. After studying accounting at Oklahoma State University, he moved into the music business, working in songwriting, record labels, management, and production. He has received numerous honors and awards for his contributions to the industry.
one_line: Tim DuBois is a Nashville music executive and Oklahoma State accounting graduate active in songwriting, labels, management, and production.
key_facts: Tim DuBois was born on May 4, 1948 in Southwest City, Missouri.
Tim DuBois is a music executive based in Nashville, Tennessee.
Tim DuBois attended Oklahoma State University.
Tim DuBois received a B.A. and M.A. in Accounting from Oklahoma State University.
In 2016 Tim DuBois was awarded an honorary PHD in Accounting.
After his accounting studies, Tim DuBois entered the music business.
Tim DuBois has taken part in songwriting, record labels, management, and production.
Tim DuBois has been recognized with numerous honors and awards for his contributions to the music industry.
